theorems.name: Submission.ecf_cp_piece_weight
theorems.statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (F : Euclid k → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid k)) (g : Euclid k → ℤ) (G : Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → Measurable g → (∀ u ∈ A, ‖F u‖ ≤ ρ) → (∀ u ∈ A, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, (fun a => fderiv ℝ G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = (Fin.cons (F u) (t • fun b => fderiv ℝ F u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P)) → ∫⁻ z in {z : Euclid (k + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid k) ∈ A}, ‖(g (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))) : ℝ)‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G z (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G z (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * ∫⁻ u in A, ‖(g u : ℝ)‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ F u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ F u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))))
